quarterly_data.quarter: Saudi Aramco press release: Aramco and Maaden sign shareholders' agreement to form (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Aramco and Maaden signed a shareholders' agreement to form a joint venture (expected 51% Maaden, 49% Aramco) for mineral exploration and hard-rock mining, mainly copper plus zinc, lead and rare earth elements, across Zone-4 of the Arabian Platform (about 182,000 square kilometers, nearly 10% of Saudi Arabia's land area); Aramco says its geological data, high-performance computing and AI are expected to accelerate discovery. Effectiveness is conditional on approvals including antitrust clearance.
quarterly_data.figure: JV 51% Maaden / 49% Aramco; about 182,000 square kilometers
